# `_data/`

Each `*.yml` file here is loaded by Jekyll as `site.data.<filename>` and consumed by Liquid loops in `_layouts/` and `_pages/`. This directory holds three kinds of files:

## Generated — do not edit by hand

These carry a `# Generated by arya-academic-hub/scripts/academic_sync.py. Do not edit by hand.` header and are produced from the canonical records in the sibling `arya-academic-data` repo (one level up, in the hub checkout). Edit the source YAML there and run the hub's sync (`docker compose run --rm sync sync --write`, see `../docs/how-to-run.md`), not these files directly:

- `pi.yml`, `recruiting.yml` — profile/recruiting facts (from `arya-academic-data/profile`, `recruiting`)
- `academic_teaching.yml` — from `arya-academic-data/teaching`
- `academic_service.yml`, `organizational_responsibilities.yml` — from `arya-academic-data/service`
- `advising.yml` — from `arya-academic-data/students`, `student_committees`
- `certifications.yml` — from `arya-academic-data/professional_development`
- `academic_talks.yml` — from `arya-academic-data/talks`

`arya-academic-data/docs/manual-updates-personal-site.md` is the canonical, up-to-date list of what's synced vs. manual for this site.

## Manually maintained, in active use

- `navigation.yml` — top nav dropdown, consumed by `_includes/header.html`
- `news.yml` — announcements list on `/allnews/`, no upstream source
- `awards.yml` — honors shown on `/about/`; hand-typed with a schema that does not match `arya-academic-data/awards`, so it is not currently sync-eligible without reconciliation work
- `events.yml` — photo-gallery event metadata for `/gallery/`
- `repositories.yml` — GitHub user/repo list for a repo-card widget

## Archived placeholders — `archive/`

`archive/people.yml`, `archive/team_members.yml`, `archive/alumni_members.yml`, `archive/alumni_visitors.yml`, `archive/collaborators.yml`, and `archive/funders.yml` are fully commented-out template placeholders, moved out of the top-level `_data/` namespace (mirrors the lab site's own `_data/archive/` convention for its unpopulated template files). The pages that used to loop over them (`team.md`, `about.md`) guard each section with `{% if site.data.<name> %}`; since these files no longer live at `_data/<name>.yml`, `site.data.<name>` is simply undefined and those guards still render nothing — identical to their behavior before the move. Kept here for possible future reuse rather than deleted.

Note: a `grants.yml` placeholder was archived alongside these initially but has since been deleted outright (not just archived) — `_pages/grants.md` already covers this data via the sync-generated pattern above (`funded_research_contributions`), and confirmed drift-free via `sync --dry-run`, so a second placeholder for the same concept added no value.
